title: InventoryKind
description: An item kind (ADR-054 §2): what items of the kind carry (an attribute schema), where they can be equipped (slots) and which surfaces render them. A new kind is a contract plus a renderer, never a new table.

slots.description: Where one item of the kind can be equipped; empty: the kind is not equippable (a collectible, a badge shown on the profile).

surface.description: Where an item of this kind shows.

renderer.description: The renderer contract the surface implements for this kind, e.g. live.name_effect.css@1.

attributes.description: A JSON Schema every definition's attributes must satisfy.

stackable.description: True: one person may hold several instances of one definition.

workshop.description: A Workshop kind (ADR-054 §6): any signed-in person may submit a definition of it, issued by and credited to them, published only after staff review.
